label: Graft
summary: Code-graph retrieval: agents ask an index where code lives, who calls a symbol and what a diff reaches, instead of grepping the tree.
why: The retrieval verbs (ask, grep, skeleton, callers, map, blast) parse with tree-sitter: no model, no API key. `graft build --deep` is the one command that calls an LLM, and cckit never runs it.

appliesWhen.note: Read from dist/graph/extract.js (depth tier) and dist/graph/generic.js (breadth tier) of @nanonets/graft 0.18.0. A file whose extension is absent is skipped, not indexed. There is no shell grammar, so a repo of only .sh files gets an empty graph and the integration is not offered there.

install.note: The upstream-documented install, and the one that runs here: 0.18.0 on darwin/arm64, Node v22.23.2.

Second on evidence: on darwin/arm64 with Node 22 (abi 127) the pnpm install exits 0 and every invocation, `graft --version` included, then dies with 'No native build was found' loaded from tree-sitter-kotlin. detect fails on that, so the runner reports the tool missing instead of installed.

writes: graft/ (the graph: init also runs `graft build`)

declined.--no-statusline: cckit ships its own statusline, and a project-level statusLine hides a user-level one. The shim file .claude/helpers/graft-statusline.cjs is still written; no statusLine key is.
declined.--no-global: Without it graft init also writes ~/.claude/settings.json, ~/.claude/helpers/graft-hooks.cjs and ~/.claude.json, which change every repo on the machine. A per-project integration stays inside the project.

kept.hooks: ON. Tested 2026-11-11 with graft 0.18.0: `graft init --agents claude --no-statusline --no-global` in a scratch repo whose .claude/settings.json already held one hook entry on each of SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PostToolUse and Stop. All four entries survived byte-identical and stayed first in their event; graft appended its own (one per event, two on PostToolUse). A second init left settings.json identical. Hooks are the push path (graft adds matching locations to a prompt unasked); the MCP server it also registers is the pull path.

build.cost: Local tree-sitter parse, no API key.

deep.cost: LLM calls under the user's own key.

afterInstall: run 'graft init --agents claude --no-statusline --no-global' in the repo to wire it

verify.failsOn: The binary is missing, or its native tree-sitter build does not load on this Node version. `graft check` is the per-repo freshness check: exit 1 when graft/ is absent or has drifted from the code.

drifts: whether graft init still preserves existing hook entries
